name: Atlas
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Atlas instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Atlas tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Atlas through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Atlas Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Atlas only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
